verdicts.rationale: Both entries are Lycan's 1987 book 'Consciousness' (MIT Press, ISBN 9780262121248) — identical fields, only a citekey spelling variant.

Both are Lycan's 'Even and even if' (1991, Linguistics and Philosophy 14(2):115-150), sharing DOI 10.1007/bf00627400 with identical title/author. The misleading 'homuncular' citekey and article/incollection type difference are cosmetic.
Both are Lycan's 1996 book 'Consciousness and experience' (MIT Press, ISBN 9780262121972) — identical fields, citekey spelling variant only.
Both are Lycan's SEP entry 'Representational theories of consciousness'. The 2000 and 2019 years are just different revision dates of the same Stanford Encyclopedia article by the same author.
Both are Lyons' 1999 book 'Definiteness' (Cambridge University Press, ISBN 9780511052439) — identical fields, citekey spelling variant only.
Both are Zacks et al. 2007 'Event perception: A mind-brain perspective' (Psychological Bulletin 133(2):273-293), sharing DOI and identical author list.
Both are Macdonald & Macdonald 1995 'Connectionism' (Blackwell, ISBN 9780631197454) — identical fields, citekey spelling variant only.
Both are Machery 2016 'De-Freuding Implicit Attitudes' (Implicit Bias and Philosophy, Vol 1, pp.104-129), sharing DOI with identical title/author/booktitle.
Both are Maciejewski & Klepousniotou 2020 'Disambiguating the ambiguity disadvantage effect' (JEP:LMC 46(9):1682-1700), sharing DOI and identical fields.

The two books (mack1998inattentional / mack1998, MIT Press, ISBN 9780262632034) are the same 1998 monograph 'Inattentional blindness' (the 2000 year on one is just a reprint). But mack2003inattentio is a DIFFERENT work: the 2003 Current Directions in Psychological Science review article (12(5):180-184, DOI 10.1111/1467-8721.01256), pulled in only via a title+author match. It should not be merged with the book.
Both are Macken, Perry & Haas 1993 'Richly Grounding Symbols In ASL' (Sign Language Studies 81(1):375-394), sharing DOI and identical fields.

Both are Mackie's 'The Cement of the Universe' — the 1974 Clarendon Press and 1980 Oxford University Press printings are the same monograph (different ISBNs reflect hardback vs later paperback issue).
Both are Spelke, Breinlinger, Macomber & Jacobson 1992 'Origins of knowledge' (Psychological Review 99(4):605-632), sharing DOI and identical author list.
Both are Maddy's 1990 'Realism in Mathematics' (Oxford University Press, ISBN 9781281980991) — identical fields including year 1990; the '1992' in one citekey is spurious.
Both are Maguire 2001 'The retrosplenial contribution to human navigation' (Scand. J. Psychol. 42:225-238), sharing DOI 10.1111/1467-9450.00233; the second is a sparser variant of the same article.
Both are Maier 2023 'Emojis as Pictures' (Ergo 10), sharing DOI and identical title/author/year.
Both are Taylor & Tversky 1996 'Perspective in Spatial Descriptions' (Journal of Memory and Language 35(3):371-391), sharing DOI and identical fields.
Both are Majaj, Hong, Solomon & DiCarlo 2015 (J. Neuroscience 35(39):13402-13418), sharing DOI and identical author list.
Both are Maki 1981 'Categorization and distance effects with spatial linear orders' (JEP:HLM 7(1):15-32); the DOI differs only by a slash-formatting artifact and all substantive fields match.
Both are Malach et al. 1995 'Object-related activity revealed by fMRI in human occipital cortex' (PNAS 92(18):8135-8139), sharing DOI and identical author list.
All three are Maloney 2003 'Surface Colour Perception and Environmental Constraints' (pp.279-306), sharing DOI and identical title/author/pages.

Both are Mandelbaum 2018 'Seeing and Conceptualizing' (PPR 97(2):267-283), sharing DOI and identical fields; the '2017' year on one citekey is a minor pub-date variant, published year is 2018 in both.
Both are Mandler 1992 'How to build a baby: II. Conceptual primitives' (Psychological Review 99(4):587-604), sharing DOI and identical fields.
Both are Mandler & Ritchey 1977 'Long-term memory for pictures' (JEP:HLM 3(4):386-396), sharing DOI and identical author/title.

Both members carry DOI 10.2307/466187 with identical title 'Socialism under the Influence', author Patricia S. Mann, and Social Text 8(19/20):223. The 'rhetorical' citekeys are misleading but the actual bib fields are fully consistent, so both describe the same work.
